Visible scene details: Convert this anime illustration into a realistic photograph of an East Asian woman, preserving every visible element exactly as in the source. The woman has very long straight dark brown hair with center-parted bangs framing her face, warm brown eyes, and a gentle faint smile; she wears small dangling earrings, fingerless leather gloves in black and deep red with metal plate accents on both hands, a white sleeveless crop tank top with black trim, and a black leather mini skirt with suspenders straps attached by metal buckles. She sits at a wooden bar table leaning forward with both elbows resting on the tabletop, both gloved hands raised to frame her cheeks near her ears, legs crossed so that only the upper thighs are visible within the frame. On the left side of the table stands a speckled cream ceramic mug printed with handwritten "Seventh Heaven" text and a small flower doodle. The background is a cozy tavern interior: on the upper right wall hangs a wooden sign reading "Seventh Heaven" in cursive script flanked by snowflake ornaments, below it shelves lined with liquor bottles under warm hanging pendant lamps, and further down a chalkboard menu listing "Good Food Good People Same Place Always." with a heart symbol; on the left, tall multi-pane windows reveal sunlit industrial towers outside, beside which sit potted green plants on a shelf; behind her on the right, empty wooden bar stools recede into depth. Lighting comes from the window on the left as soft directional daylight mixed with warm tungsten glow from the pendant bulbs, casting consistent highlights on her skin, hair, and the wood surfaces. Render natural photographic skin texture without over-smoothing or added blemishes, keep all readable text identical, preserve the same composition, framing, pose, occlusions, and camera viewpoint, changing only the medium from anime to photorealistic.
